### The Desires of Your Heart
Author: Megan J. Conner
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-desires-of-your-heart-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 37:4
Points:
- People often assume that attaining earthly dreams and ideal circumstances will bring lasting peace.
- Worldly accomplishments and possessions are shallow substitutes that leave an underlying void.
- God formed each person intimately and understands our soul's deepest longings better than we do.
- The fundamental desire wired into the human heart is genuine communion with the Lord Himself.
- Lasting contentment comes when we shift our pursuit from temporary fixes to delighting in God.

### Trusting God When a Beloved Season of Life Ends
Author: Lyli Dunbar
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/trusting-god-when-a-beloved-season-of-life-ends.html
Passage: Psalm 37:5
Points:
- Major life transitions and unexpected endings often stir up intense anxiety and fear of the unknown.
- David’s psalms remind believers that they can bring raw, vulnerable emotions directly to God.
- Committing our path to the Lord involves rolling the heavy burden of worry off our own shoulders.
- God is never caught off guard by endings and remains constant when life circumstances shift.
- Believers can move forward in confident expectation that God will empower and direct their future.

### Trusting God When Others Treat Us Unjustly
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/trusting-god-when-others-treat-us-unjustly-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 37:7
Points:
- Experiencing deliberate mistreatment or sabotage easily triggers panic, defensiveness, and anger.
- Jumping into self-defense or retaliation often amplifies harm rather than fixing the problem.
- David suffered years of wrongful persecution under Saul yet repeatedly entrusted his vindication to God.
- Being still in God's presence provides the strength and wisdom needed to respond constructively.
- Human injustice cannot thwart the good, ultimate purposes God has established for His followers.

### Ordered Steps and Gentle Guidance
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/ordered-steps-and-gentle-guidance.html
Passage: Psalm 37:23
Points:
- Fear of the unknown often paralyzes believers into demanding a complete roadmap before moving forward.
- Waiting for absolute certainty or effortless confidence delays taking the faithful steps God requires.
- God promises to establish and steady our steps one by one rather than showing every future milestone.
- Key biblical figures like Abraham and Moses had to follow God's call without knowing every detail in advance.
- Stepping forward into an unclear future allows God to illuminate and guide each subsequent step.
